name: Notebook
description: Simple admin notebook for storing subject/body/phone notes in a custom database table.
project_description:
Notebook module is created for enhancing functionality of Drupal. It provides admin or user to add memory or notes in busy circumstances. It is very useful module.

 Features 
 - Add notes, notes can be edited an can be seen when required.

- It is very useful for official purpose to save essential information.

- I has fully responsive layout environment.

 Post-Installation 
 Simply install module and clear cache, this module link will be appeared in admin menu as mention link title Notebook. Click the link and use this module.
